cm:stacks:export.Name: cm:stacks:export
cm:stacks:export.description: The cm:stacks:export command lets you export content from one stack to another

--alias.Name: --alias
--alias.description: The management token of the source stack from which you will export content

--branch.Name: --branch
--branch.description: The name of the branch where you want to export your content. If you don’t mention the branch name, then by default the content will be exported from all the branches of your stack

--data-dir.Name: --data-dir
--data-dir.description: The path or the location in your file system to store the exported content. For e.g., ./content

--module.Name: --module
--module.description: [optional] Specific module name. If not specified, the export command will export all the modules to the stack. The available modules are assets, content-types, entries, environments, extensions, global-fields, labels, locales, webhooks, and workflows

--stack-api-key.Name: --stack-api-key
--stack-api-key.description: API key of the source stack

-d.description: The path or the location in your file system to store the exported content. For e.g., ./content
